tier: # Every rule is tried against the Project column (case-insensitive regular expression). Lines starting with # are ignored.
# The matching rule with the lowest tier wins. Within a tier the keyword that appears first in the project name wins.
# If rules in the same tier point to different goals the tag is marked medium and the other goal becomes the secondary.
# Goals are written SDG 1 to SDG 17 or General (budget support and balance of payments).

pattern: budget(ary)? support|expenditure support|emergency support loan|balance of payments?|\bBoP\b|development policy|\bDPO\b|\bDPF\b|policy.based|programme loan|program loan
rule: budget or balance of payments support
